v9_baseline.reporting_totals: Frozen prior principal v9, with its own coverage/count replacement; never reconstructed on rerun.
v9_baseline.price_context: Live case API excluding21 supplies direct item21 price and matching common rate only; its total is not the reporting baseline.
v9_baseline.scope: Direct item21 price added to frozen prior principal v9 at fixed16/11; coverage and count interactions remain separately reported. This is not a full optimized-case inclusion/exclusion difference.

limits: Fixed 16/11 personal endpoints; no fresh endpoint optimization.
Count interactions remain separate from source item21; parent case integration owns their application.
Alternative source arms retain their own measured source population/coverage prices; full v9 arm-specific coverage/count kernels require separate parent outputs.
